records.guideline: NICE NG226: Osteoarthritis in over 16s — diagnosis and management
records.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
records.statement: Do not offer acupuncture or dry needling for managing osteoarthritis.

source.title: NICE NG226: Osteoarthritis in over 16s — diagnosis and management

records.guideline: 2019 ACR/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee
records.publisher: American College of Rheumatology / Arthritis Foundation
records.statement: Acupuncture is conditionally recommended for knee, hip and hand osteoarthritis.

source.title: 2019 ACR/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee

records.guideline: NICE NG59: Low back pain and sciatica in over 16s — assessment and management
records.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
records.statement: Do not offer acupuncture for managing low back pain with or without sciatica.

records.guideline: Noninvasive Treatments for Acute, Subacute, and Chronic Low Back Pain (clinical practice guideline)
records.statement: For chronic low back pain, clinicians and patients should initially select non-drug treatment, which includes acupuncture among the options (weak recommendation, low-quality evidence).

records.guideline: NICE CG150: Headaches in over 12s — diagnosis and management
records.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
records.statement: Consider a course of up to 10 sessions of acupuncture over 5 to 8 weeks for the prophylactic treatment of chronic tension-type headache.
